question: For each port status and device owner, considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks (i.e., networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant = '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the number of ports and the earliest (minimum) standard attribute updated timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.status, p.device_owner, COUNT(p.id) AS num_ports, MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated
FROM ports p
JOIN standardattributes sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
  AND p.network_id NOT IN (
    SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
    WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
      AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner;
